description: Get converted coordinates for a bounding box or natural-language location search (powered by Nominatim with configurable Photon & optional Mapbox fallbacks). Supports parsing WKT, GeoJSON, ogrinfo extent, Web Mercator tiles ('z/x/y'), single points ('lat,lng'), and raw coordinate strings, plus optional metric buffering.

bbox.description: The geometry to parse. Can be a raw bounding box string ('lat1,lng1,lat2,lng2'), a single point ('lat,lng'), a Web Mercator tile ('z/x/y'), a WKT polygon/linestring/point, a GeoJSON payload, or an `ogrinfo` extent block. Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

buffer_meters.description: Optional distance in meters to expand (positive) or shrink (negative) the bounding box in all directions. Ideal for creating a bounding box around a single point.

coord_order.description: Toggle between 'lng,lat' (default) and 'lat,lng' coordinate ordering in the formatted output. Useful for APIs that expect swapped coordinate orders.

epsg.description: The projected EPSG code (e.g. '3857'). Defaults to '4326' (WGS84). Over 3,900 bundled projections; unknown codes are auto-fetched from epsg.io.

format.description: Format of the output. Options: wkt, geojson-bbox, leaflet, overpass, ogc-bbox, kml, geojson-polygon, csv, stac-bbox. Default: csv.

location.description: A text location to search for (e.g. 'New York City', 'Central Park'). Uses OpenStreetMap Nominatim (or configurable NOMINATIM_API_URL / PHOTON_API_URL / optional MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN). Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

precision.description: The number of decimal places to output coordinate strings as (defaults to 6).

zoom.description: The map zoom level (0-22) used to calculate the map tile coordinates for the centroid. Defaults to 15.

name: get_bounds
